testMapsEveryAvailableWheelField.desc: Checks that all the fields of a wheel (names, vidpid, productId/vendorId, GUID, FFB, revisions, controls, controlCounts) are carried over.

testUnknownDefaultUpdateRateStaysAbsent.desc: Checks that without a valid FFB sampling period, neither the period nor maxRawFfbUpdateRateHz is set.

testEnglishNameComesOnlyFromOfficialInpu.desc: Checks that the English name is read from /settings/inputmaps/<vidpid>.json when the file is official.

testUnofficialInputMapCannotSupplyTeleme.desc: Checks that an unofficial input table cannot provide a name.

testNonWheelsKeepOnlyCommonIdentity.desc: Checks that a device that is not a wheel only keeps type, productName, vidpid and forceFeedback.

testSymbolicDeviceIdentityKeepsItsCase.desc: Checks that a symbolic identifier (e.g. 'XIDevice') is not uppercased.
